circuit:
* Low-power class-AB line driver, Sky130 1.8 V CMOS
* Two-stage Miller amp with Monticelli-style class-AB output biasing.
* Input 5T stage: NMOS pair M1/M2, PMOS mirror MP3:MP4 = 1:1 (MP3 also
* carries the 5u abp bias branch, keeping the vgp node balance exact:
* MP4(25u) = M2(20u) + MFN(5u)).  Floating coupler pair MFN/MFP joins the
* two output gate nodes vgp/vgn.  Quiescent output current is fixed by the
* all-NMOS translinear loop Vgs(MD1)+Vgs(MD2) = Vgs(MFN)+Vgs(MON).
* MFP idles near cutoff: its gate abp = d2 - 5u*RAB tracks vdd minus one
* PMOS Vsg plus a resistor drop, so it conducts only when vgp rises during
* sinking, passing the MP4 branch current into vgn (class-AB sink drive).
* Pin order: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt low_power_line_driver vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---- NMOS bias mirrors (unit W=10 L=2 carries 5u) ----
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 m=10
XMT  tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 m=8
XMNB1 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 m=1
XMN4 vgn  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 m=1
XMNB2 abp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 m=1
* ---- PMOS bias (unit W=7 L=2; MPB0 4 units at 5u, MPB1 2 units -> 2.5u) ----
XMPB0 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 m=4
XMPB1 abn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=7 m=2
* ---- input pair ----
XM1 d2  vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 m=7
XM2 vgp vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 m=7
* ---- PMOS mirror (MP3 carries M1 20u + RAB branch 5u; MP4 25u) ----
XMP3 d2  d2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=7 m=30
XMP4 vgp d2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=7 m=30
* ---- class-AB bias: N reference stack and abp level shift ----
XMD1 nsm nsm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 m=10
XMD2 abn abn nsm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 m=10
RAB d2 abp 40k
* ---- Monticelli floating coupler pair ----
XMFN vgp abn vgn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 m=20
XMFP vgn abp vgp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 m=2
* ---- output stage: complementary common source ----
XMOP vout vgp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 m=50
XMON vout vgn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=6.4 m=100
* ---- compensation: RC Miller to both gates ----
CC1 vout cx1 4p
RZ1 cx1 vgp 6k
CC2 vout cx2 4p
RZ2 cx2 vgn 6k
.ends low_power_line_driver

circuit:
* Low-power line driver: two-stage amplifier
* Stage 1: NMOS-input folded cascode
* Stage 2: complementary common-source pair with floating Monticelli class-AB bias
* iref: 50 uA pushed into iref pin by testbench (NMOS diode master to vss)
* All devices keep total w >= 8 um so binned models stay in the w=[7,1010]um row.

* NMOS current-mirror master at iref (50 uA)

* sink for class-AB P bias stack, ~4 uA (5-series stack)
XMBPSA vbpt iref p1m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

XMBPSE p4m  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2

* PMOS mirror master diode (~10 uA)
XMPB0 pmst pmst vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
* source for NMOS cascode bias generator, ~5 uA (2-series stack)
XMPCNA n1m  pmst vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2

* source for class-AB N bias stack, ~5 uA (2-series stack)
XMPBNA n2m  pmst vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2

XMNCD vcnt vcnt ncr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=8 w=8 nf=1
RCN   ncr vss 10k
* PMOS cascode gate bias: resistor + diode from vdd
RCP   vdd pcr 15k
XMPCD vcpt vcpt pcr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=3 w=9 nf=1

* ---------- stage 1: NMOS input pair, folded cascode ----------
XMI1  fnl vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=8
XMI2  fnr vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=8

XMPS2 fnr pmst vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=2
* top PMOS cascodes (branch ~10 uA)

XMPC2 gp vcpt fnr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=30 nf=4
* bottom NMOS cascodes
XMNC1 dl vcnt bl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=8 nf=2
XMNC2 gn vcnt br vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=8 nf=2
* bottom NMOS wide-swing mirror (gates at left cascode drain)
XMNM1 bl dl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=8 nf=2
XMNM2 br dl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=8 nf=2

* ---------- class-AB bias stacks ----------
* vbnt = Vgs(MD1) + Vgs(MD2), MD2 is 1/5 replica of output NMOS at ~5 uA
XMD1  vbnt vbnt md1s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=9.6 nf=2
XMD2  md1s md1s vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=72 nf=6
* vbpt = vdd - Vsg(MD4) - Vsg(MD3), MD4 is 1/5 replica of output PMOS at ~4 uA

XMD3  vbpt vbpt md2s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=4

* ---------- Monticelli floating class-AB mesh ----------
XMABN gp vbnt gn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2
XMABP gn vbpt gp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=4

* ---------- stage 2: complementary common-source output ----------
XMPO  vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=960 nf=64
XMNO  vout gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=480 nf=32

* ---------- Miller compensation ----------
CCP   vout gp 2.2p
CCN   vout gn 2.2p

.ends low_power_line_driver

circuit:
* Low-power class-AB line driver (Sky130 1.8 V devices, ideal R/C only).
*
* Two-stage Miller amplifier with a complementary common-source output pair.
* Stage 1: NMOS-input current-mirror OTA; its rail-to-rail output node na
*          drives the output PMOS gate directly.
* Class-AB: floating (quasi-floating-gate) battery CBAT/RBIG between the two
*          output gates.  At DC the output NMOS gate nb sits at the 50 uA
*          iref diode voltage (2:1 mirror -> ~100 uA quiescent current), so
*          the quiescent current is set by iref at every PVT point without
*          stacking the high-|Vt| PMOS devices; at signal frequencies nb
*          follows na, giving push-pull drive of 2 mA into the 300 ohm line.
.subckt low_power_line_driver vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* --- bias: 50 uA reference diode (also DC gate bias of the output NMOS)
XMR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
* --- input pair, 12 uA tail
XMT tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XMI1 d1 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMI2 d2 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XML1 d1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=64 nf=8
XML2 d2 d2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=64 nf=8
* --- mirrors into the first-stage output node na
* (XMPA is 4% wider than XML1 to centre the systematic offset over PVT)
XMPA na d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=66.56 nf=8
XMPB ne d2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=64 nf=8
XMNE ne ne vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=32 nf=8
XMNB na ne vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=32 nf=8
* --- floating class-AB battery between the output gates
CBAT na nb 8p
RBIG iref nb 20meg
* --- complementary common-source output pair
XM1 vout na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=300 nf=30
XM2 vout nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
* --- Miller compensation with nulling resistor (LHP zero near output pole)
RZ na nz 5k
CC nz vout 4p
.ends low_power_line_driver

circuit:
* Low-power line driver for a 300 ohm AC-coupled line.
* Two-stage amplifier:
*   - NMOS differential input pair with a PMOS mirror load.
*   - Complementary common-source class-AB output stage using a floating
*     Monticelli bias (RFLT || CFLT between the two output gates).  The bias
*     current is forced by mirrors of a supply/threshold tracking
*     diode-resistor-diode stack, so the gate overdrive sum tracks PVT.
*   - Miller compensation from the first-stage output to vout.
* Device notes:
*   - Input pair is kept narrow (w=30) so its Vgs is large; this lowers the
*     first-stage output floor (na >= ntail ~= vinn - Vgs) and therefore lets
*     the class-AB PMOS gate swing far enough to drive the line at the
*     positive output peak.
*   - Output PMOS is split into two instances (w=900 + w=1000) to stay below
*     the model's 1010 um maximum width per device while providing the ~2 mA
*     peak current.
.subckt low_power_line_driver vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- input bias reference (iref sinks 50 uA) ----
XMNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2

* ---- differential input pair and tail current ----
XMTAIL ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XM1 n1 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=2
XM2 na vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=2
XM3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=2
XM4 na n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=2

* ---- floating class-AB bias generator ----
XMP0 xb xb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
RBIAS xb yb 100k
XMN0 yb yb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMPB gpb xb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMNB na yb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
RFLT gpb na 190k
CFLT gpb na 4p

* ---- complementary common-source output stage ----
XMPO vout gpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=900 nf=30
XMPO2 vout gpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1000 nf=30
XMNO vout na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=10

* ---- Miller compensation ----
CC na vout 5.5p

.ends low_power_line_driver

circuit:
* Low-power class-AB line driver for a 300 ohm AC-coupled load (Sky130, 1.8 V)
*
* Two-stage amplifier:
*  - NMOS input pair (isolated p-well tied to its common source) folded into a
*    PMOS-source / PMOS-cascode top and an NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror.
*  - Floating (Monticelli) class-AB control MA/MB between the output gates pg/ng.
*    The quiescent output current is set by the NMOS translinear loop
*    (MNd1+MNd2 = MNO+MB); the PMOS loop (MPd1+MPd2 = MPO+MA) lets ng rise
*    when sinking. At low supply/cold its bias sink saturates and MA idles.
*  - Complementary common-source output pair (L=0.18 PMOS for low-supply drive).
*  - Hybrid compensation: cascode (Ahuja) caps from vout into the low-impedance
*    cascode sources f2/b2 set a UGB that is insensitive to the weak quiescent
*    output-stage gain into 300 ohm; small direct Miller caps keep the local
*    output loop first-order (no ringing) when the output stage carries mA.
*  - All bias currents are mirrored from the 50 uA iref input.
.subckt low_power_line_driver vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* bias reference: 50 uA into a diode-connected NMOS
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=8
* input-pair tail current
XMTAIL tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=6.4 nf=1
* NMOS input pair (isolated p-well tied to the common source)
XM1 f1 vinn tail tail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=8
XM2 f2 vinp tail tail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=8
* PMOS source bias and cascode bias (resistor level shift)
XMPB1 vbps vbps vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=44 nf=4
RCP vbps vcp 22000
XMNB1 vcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
* NMOS cascode bias
XMPB2 vcn vbps vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=22 nf=2
RCN vcn vcnd 100000
XMNB2 vcnd vcnd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=4 nf=1
* folded-cascode summing circuit: PMOS sources + cascodes
XMP1 f1 vbps vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=8
XMP2 f2 vbps vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=8
XMP3 d4 vcp f1 f1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMP4 pg vcp f2 f2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
* NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror
XMN1 b1 d4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=1
XMN3 d4 vcn b1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMN2 b2 d4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=8 nf=1
XMN4 ng vcn b2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* floating class-AB control pair (bodies tied to sources)
XMA ng vbpab pg pg sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=10 nf=2
XMB pg vbnab ng ng sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

* Low-power line driver for a 300 ohm AC-coupled line (Sky130, 1.8 V core).

* Topology (two-stage, class-AB):
*  - NMOS-input folded-cascode first stage (input CM is fixed at 0.9 V).
*    Tail current from a Widlar source off the iref diode (mildly PTAT,
*    process independent) to flatten gm1 over temperature.
*  - Floating Monticelli class-AB control (MB1 PMOS || MB2 NMOS) between the
*    output gates ga/gb, driven by the folded-cascode summing branches; a
*    matched floating copy (MB3/MB4) keeps the left branch symmetric.
*    The NMOS translinear loop (MN5+MN6 vs MNO+MB2) sets the quiescent
*    current; the PMOS loop (MP5+MP6 vs MPO+MB1) is deliberately weak (the
*    Sky130 pfet |VT|~1 V makes a 2-VSG stack unusable at 1.62 V / cold) and
*    mainly lets MB1 pull gb up when the output sinks.
*  - Complementary common-source output pair: PMOS L=0.18 (drive at 0.12 V
*    VSD on a 1.62 V supply, low DIBL), NMOS L=0.5.
*  - Miller compensation from vout to both output gates.

* quiescent current ~47 uA, tail 11 uA, summing branches ~4.5 uA.

* ---------------- bias (all derived from the 50 uA at iref) ----------------
* iref diode: 25 unit fingers (w/nf=2, l=2) -> ~2 uA per unit mirror finger

* PMOS bias diode (vbp) for the top current sources
XMNB1 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1
XMPB0 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
* PMOS cascode bias: RBPC drop sets the VSD of the top current sources
RBPC vdd pcs 75000
XMPC0 vbpc vbpc pcs vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMNB2 vbpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=2 nf=1

XMPB2 vbnc vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
XMNC0 vbnc vbnc ncs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1

XMP6 vgb1 vgb1 p5 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=16 nf=4

* Low-power line driver for a 300 ohm AC-coupled line.
*
* Topology: current-mirror (two-output) input stage driving a complementary
* common-source output pair through a floating class-AB cell.  The n-side of
* the cell is a translinear (Monticelli) loop referenced to vss, which sets
* the output-stage quiescent current; the global feedback loop then forces the
* p-side output current to match it.  A short-channel output pmos is used
* because |vth| of the 1.8 V pfet falls from ~0.99 V at L=0.5 to ~0.72 V at
* L=0.15, which is what makes a class-AB bias fit under a 1.62 V rail.
*
* Pin order: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt low_power_line_driver vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*** ------------------------- bias core -------------------------
* 50 uA reference sink
XMR0  iref iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=1 W=56 nf=8
* source-degenerated mirror: PTAT-like master current (~5 uA) so that gm
* tracks 1/(n*kT/q) and the loop bandwidth stays flat over temperature
XMR1  nma  iref nrs  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=1 W=56 nf=8
RDEG  nrs  vss 30k
* master p-side bias (nma) and n-side bias (nbn)
XMP0  nma  nma  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=2 W=28 nf=4
XMP1  nbn  nma  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=2 W=28 nf=4
XMN1  nbn  nbn  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=2 W=14 nf=2

*** ------------------------- input stage -------------------------
XMT   ts   nbn  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=2 W=28 nf=4
XM1   d1   vinn ts   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=42 nf=6
XM2   d2   vinp ts   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=42 nf=6
XM3   d1   d1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=2 W=28 nf=4
XM4   d2   d2   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=2 W=28 nf=4
* in-phase current injection into the two output-driver nodes
XM5   gp   d1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=2 W=28 nf=4
XM6   nx   d2   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=2 W=28 nf=4
XM7   nx   nx   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=4 W=14 nf=2
XM8   gn   nx   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=4 W=14 nf=2

*** --------------------- floating class-AB cell ---------------------
* n-side floating device sets the quiescent point (isolated body)
XMFN  gp   vbn2 gn   gn  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=10 nf=2
* p-side floating device provides the pull-up path for gn on large signals
XMFP  gn   vbp2 gp   gp  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=16 nf=4
* ac short so both gates move together in the signal band
CAB   gp   gn 20p
RAB   gp   gn 20meg

* n-side translinear stack: vbn2 = vgs(MFN replica) + vgs(output nmos replica)
XMPB1 vbn2 nma  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=2 W=14 nf=2
XMRA  vbn2 vbn2 nm   nm  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=5 nf=1
XMRB  nm   nm   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=5 nf=1

* p-side stack: vbp2 = vdd - vsg(output pmos replica) - vsg(MFP replica).
* Self-biased through RPB so that it never runs out of headroom at 1.62 V.
XMRC  ny   ny   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=0.15 W=3.5 nf=1
XMRD  vbp2 vbp2 ny   ny  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=12 nf=2
XMNB1 vbp2 nbn  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=4 W=1.5 nf=1
RPB   vbp2 vss 20meg

*** --------------------- class-AB output pair ---------------------
XMOP  vout gp   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 L=0.15 W=300 nf=50
XMON  vout gn   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 L=0.5 W=120 nf=20

*** ------------------------- compensation -------------------------
CC    gp   vout 1.5p

.ends low_power_line_driver

*            (~class-AB, tens of uA each).  No floating diodes => no latch.

*   Stage 1: NMOS differential pair with PMOS current-mirror load. The
*   mirror sums both half-circuit signals at v1, giving non-inverting gain.
*   (NMOS input pair is mandatory: inputs sit at ~0.9 V and the PMOS devices
*   in this library have |Vth| ~ 0.9 V.)
*   Stage 2: class-AB push-pull current-mirror output stage. v1 drives NMOS
*   M_g, which sinks the diode PMOS M_p1; M_p2 mirrors that source current to
*   the output. v1 also drives NMOS M_h, which shunts the bias current I_py
*   away from diode M_n1; M_n2 mirrors the remainder as sink current. Both
*   output devices are common-source, so vout swings close to the rails, and
*   quiescent output current is set by mirror ratios (supply independent).
*   Compensation: Miller capacitor across the inverting v1 -> y sub-path,
*   with a series resistor to place a zero near the y-node pole (Ahuja).
*
* Pin order: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* iref sinks 50 uA from the testbench and generates the NMOS bias rail.
*
.subckt low_power_line_driver vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
*
* ---- Bias generation --------------------------------------------------
* iref diode: NMOS gate-bias rail (node iref itself), ~0.9 V.
X_irf iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* PMOS bias rail: ~5 uA branch defines pbias = vdd - |Vgs|.
X_nb2 pbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1
X_pb pbias pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
*
* ---- First stage: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load --------------------
X_t t iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.5 nf=1
X1n d1 vinp t t sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=3
X2n v1 vinn t t sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=3
X3p d1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.3 nf=1
X4p v1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3.3 nf=1
*
* ---- Output stage: class-AB push-pull current mirrors -----------------
* PMOS side: v1 high -> M_g sinks more -> x low -> M_p2 sources more.
X_p1 x x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40.5 nf=6
X_g x v1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
X_p2 vout x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=420 nf=63
* NMOS side: v1 high -> M_h shunts I_py -> less current in M_n1 -> less sink.
X_py y pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
X_n1 y y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.25 nf=1
X_h y v1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=6
X_n2 vout y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=250 nf=36
*
* ---- Compensation ------------------------------------------------------
* Miller capacitor across the inverting v1 -> y path; series resistor moves
* the resulting zero onto the y-node pole.
R_s v1 ns 25k
C_cy ns y 8p
*
.ends low_power_line_driver

* Low-power line driver for a 300 ohm AC-coupled line.
* Two-stage amplifier:
*   Stage 1: NMOS input pair (tail mirrored from iref) with PMOS
*            current-mirror load, single-ended output node fp. Pair gates
*            are crossed internally so fp rises when vinn rises.
*   Stage 2: complementary common-source class-AB output pair.
*     - NMOS M6 gate driven directly from fp; its quiescent current is
*       set by the global loop to equal the PMOS quiescent current.
*     - PMOS M7 gate gp held at vdd-|Vgs(M8)| by diode M8 carrying a
*       mirrored fraction of iref: Ip_q = (W7/W8)*I(M8), nearly supply
*       independent. Signal reaches gp through Ccp (corner a few kHz) so
*       both gates track fp over the signal band.
* Miller compensation Rz+Cc from fp to vout.
.subckt low_power_line_driver vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- Bias (iref sinks 50 uA from vdd) ----
* NMOS diode at iref
XM0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
* Tail current: 0.6x iref, mirrored from the iref diode
XMTAIL csn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
* PMOS output-gate bias sink, 0.4x iref (~20 uA)
XMB3 gp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---- First stage ----
* Input pair (gates crossed for phase): M1 gate=vinn, M2 gate=vinp
XM1 d1 vinn csn csn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=193.2 nf=28
XM2 fp vinp csn csn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=193.2 nf=28
* PMOS mirror load
XM3 d1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=193.2 nf=28
XM4 fp d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=193.2 nf=28

* ---- Output stage ----
XM6 vout fp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=8
XM7 vout gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=500 nf=72
* Class-AB bias diode; Ip_q = (W7/W8)*20u ~ 35 uA
XM8 gp gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=285.5 nf=41
* AC coupling fp -> gp
CCP fp gp 20p

* ---- Miller compensation ----
RZ fp cz 360
CC cz vout 12p
.ends low_power_line_driver

* Low-power line driver - v12 (stages 1-2 only, vout = g, no output stage)

.subckt low_power_line_driver vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
RREF iref vss 13k
XMPTAIL s vgn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=1
XMN1 n1 vinp s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMN2 x vinn s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMP3 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XMP4 x n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1

* Low-power line driver for a 300 ohm AC-coupled line.
*
* Architecture:
*  - First stage: NMOS input pair with PMOS diode loads. i1 is mirrored
*    into the high-impedance node gn1; gn1 is balanced by a fixed sink
*    equal to half the tail current (mirrored from the iref diode).
*    A soft resistor clamps gn1 to the input common mode (vinp), which
*    is the output-swing reference, keeping the node at a sane level at
*    every supply without injecting noticeable signal current.
*  - The output gates are generated from gn1 by two single-diode
*    level-shift batteries: gn2 = gn1 - Vgs_n (down chain) and
*    gp2 = gn1 + |Vgs_p| (up chain), giving push-pull class-AB drive.
*    The chain currents are servo-trimmed (vc) against a 1:50 replica
*    of the output NMOS current to hold the quiescent output current
*    near target over PVT.
*  - Miller compensation with a series nulling resistor from vout to gn1.
*
* Pin order: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt low_power_line_driver vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias core. The external 50uA enters iref and is sunk by diode XMB0.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* Tail current source for the input pair (~25u).
XMT st iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6.6 nf=1
* PMOS bias pbx = vdd - |Vgs(5u)|.
XNB_B pbx iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XPB_B pbx pbx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* First stage.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XM1 dn1 vinn st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
XM2 dn2 vinp st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
* PMOS diode loads for both drains.
XM3 dn1 dn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XM6 dn2 dn2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
* Startup seed between the two input drains.
RSD1 dn1 dn2 10meg
* gn1: sourced by a copy of i1, sunk by a fixed Itail/2 mirror.
XM4 gn1 dn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=12 nf=2
XIx1 gn1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=3.3 nf=1
* Soft clamp of gn1 to the input common-mode level.
RCLAMP gn1 vinp 3meg
* gp1: sourced by a copy of i2, sunk by a fixed Itail/2 mirror.
XM7 gp1 dn2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=12 nf=2
XIx2 gp1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=3.3 nf=1
RCLMP2 gp1 vinp 3meg
* Up follower: gp2 = gp1 + |Vgs_fp|; current set by the servo (vc via nc).
XMfp vss gp1 gp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28 nf=4
XIsrc gp2 nc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XMPD nc nc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XMxc nc vc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Class-AB gate-drive batteries referenced to gn1.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Down follower: gn2 = gn1 - Vgs_fn; current set by the servo (vc).
XMfn vdd gn1 gn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=2
XIsnks gn2 vc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output stage.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMN vout gn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=150 nf=25
XMP vout gp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=360 nf=60

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Class-AB servo: 1:50 replica of the output NMOS sources into rr; a
* reference sinks from rr. The filtered error drives vc, trimming both
* battery currents so the quiescent output current stays on target.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
XMNr q gn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=3 nf=1
XPQ q q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XPR rr q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
* Reference sink ~0.5-0.7u (sets ~25-35u quiescent in the output NMOS).
XP_ref2 nbq pbx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=1 nf=1
XNB_q nbq nbq vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=0.42 nf=1
XNref rr nbq vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=3 w=0.42 nf=1
* Servo filter.
Rf rr vc 30meg
Crv vc vss 5p
Rbias vc d2bias 30meg
* Quiet reference for Rbias: copy of the dn1 diode level.
Rd2b d2bias dn1 100k
Cd2b d2bias vss 2p

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CN vout rzn 3.3p
RZN rzn gn1 1.2k

.ends low_power_line_driver
